import copy
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); o=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(w):
        col=[g[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        segs=[]; j=0
        while j<h:
            if col[j]:
                cc=col[j]; s=j
                while j<h and col[j]==cc: j+=1
                segs.append((cc,s,j-s))
            else: j+=1
        for cc,s,L in segs:
            up=s-L-1
            lo=s
            # extend up while empty and no horizontal row
            rr=up
            while rr>=0 and g[rr][c]==0 and rr not in {r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r])>1}:
                o[rr][c]=cc; rr-=1
            # extend down similarly
            rr=s+L+1
            while rr<h and g[rr][c]==0 and rr not in {r for r in range(h) if sum(1 for x in g[r])>1}:
                o[rr][c]=cc; rr+=1
    return o

def segs_along(line):
    n=len(line); out=[]; j=0
    while j<n:
        if line[j]:
            c=line[j]; s=j
            while j<n and line[j]==c: j+=1
            out.append((c,s,j-s))

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    def step(o):
        # vertical extend (each color in each column)
        new=[r[:] for r in o]
        for j in range(w):
            col=[o[i][j] for i in range(h)]
            i=0
            while i<h:
                if col[i]==0: i+=1; continue
                s=i
                while i<h and col[i]==col[s]: i+=1
                c=col[s]
                # extend up
                r=s
                while r-1>=0 and col[r-1]==0: r-=1
                for k in range(r,s): new[k][j]=c
                # extend down
                r=i-1
                while r+1<h and col[r+1]==0: r+=1
                for k in range(s,r+1): new[k][j]=c
        # horizontal internal gap fill
        for i in range(h):
            row=o[i]; cur=None; prev=-1
            for j in range(w):
                v=row[j]
                if v==0: continue
                if cur is not None and v==cur:
                    pass
                elif cur is not None and v!=cur:
                    for k in range(prev+1, j): new[i][k]=cur
                cur=v; prev=j
            if cur is not None:
                for k in range(prev+1, w): new[i][k]=cur
        return new
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for _ in range(20):
        o=step(o)
        if o==[[r[:] for r in o] for r in []] or True:
            break
    return o

t=[r[:] for r in G['Test input']]
h=len(t); w=len(t[0])
# identify content rows (non-empty)
rows=[i for i in range(h) if any(x!=0 for x in t[i])]
bands={}
for i in rows:
    c=t[i][0]
    if c==0: continue
    # collect cells of this color on this row
    cells=[j for j in range(w) if t[i][j]!=0]
    bands.setdefault(c,[]).append((i,cells))
out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
cur=0
order=sorted(bands)
for c in order:
    for i,cells in bands[c]:
        minc=min(cells); maxc=max(cells)
        for j in range(minc,maxc+1): out[cur][j]=c
        cur+=1
# vertical 6 fragment: rows 13,14 col3 -> band rows cur..cur+1
if (13, [3]) in [] or False: None
# find 6 and 8 locations
six=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if t[i][j]==6]
eight=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if t[i][j]==8]
for i,j in six: out[cur][j]=6; cur+=1
for i,j in eight: out[cur][j]=8; cur+=1
print(json.dumps(out)); print(cur)

# Hypothesis: cross-fill. out[i][j] = color c if row i contains c OR col j contains c.
def crf(ki):
    H,W=len(ki),len(ki[0])
    rows=[set(r) for r in ki]; cols=[set(ki[i][j] for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)]
    out=[[None]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            cand=rows[i]|cols[j]
            out[i][j]=cand.pop() if len(cand)==1 else None
    return out
for n in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
    ki=G[n+' input']; ko=G[n+' output']
    p=crf(ki)
    d=[(i,j,ko[i][j],p[i][j]) for i in range(len(ki)) for j in range(len(ki[0])) if ko[i][j]!=p[i][j]]
    print(n, len(d), d[:6])

def runs_in_row(row):
    res=[];cur=None
    for v in row:
        if v!=0 and cur is None:
            st=len(row);end=0
            while end<len(row) and row[end]==v: end+=1
            res.append((st,end,v));cur=v
        elif v==0 and cur is not None:
            break
    return res

def f(ki):
    H,W=len(ki),len(ki[0])
    bars=[i for i in range(H) if any(x for x in ki[i])]
    if not bars: return [r[:] for r in ki]
    out=[[ki[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    # band fills: for each band between consecutive bars (interior rows), and band above first bar
    def band_fill(topb, botb):
        t=topb+1; b=botb
        while t<b:
            j=0
            while j<W:
                j2=j
                while j2<W and ki[t][j2]==0: j2+=1
                if j2==j: break
                # color: bar below containing j
                cand=None
                for st,en,c in runs_in_row(ki[botb]):
                    if st<=j<=en: cand=c;break
                if cand is None:
                    fr=ki[botb][j-1] if j>0 else None
                    sr=ki[botb][j+1] if j+1<W else None
                    cand=fr if (fr and not sr) else (sr if sr and not fr else (fr==sr and fr else None))
                out[t][j]=cand
                j=j2
            t+=1
    for a,b in zip([(-1,)+bars], bars[1:] if len(bars)>1 else []):
        if a>=0 and b>a: band_fill(a,b)
    # last band: below last bar -> nothing? (demo1 rows10-14 handled by runs)
    # vertical runs fill upward
    for j in range(W):
        col=[ki[i][j] for i in range(H)]
